decisions: Skill descriptions with a CP cost: the Japanese pads with full-width spaces so 'CP:' sits at a fixed column. Written as '<description>  CP: n' (two ASCII spaces, ASCII digits); the orchestrator may re-pad for alignment.
ittei jikan ('for a set time') rendered 'Temporarily' throughout; pinch-ji = 'in a pinch'; nouryoku / nouryokuchi = 'stats'.
Faction-affinity skills (S01619-S01626) use the short faction names: Federation, Zeon, AEUG, Titans, Axis, Neo Zeon, Crossbone Vanguard, Federation (F91 era).
Ship part names: hontai = Hull, houdai = Turret, kijuu = Machine Gun; A/B/2 suffixes kept.
Progress-mode labels: LB/NZ/CV abbreviations kept (Londo Bell / Neo Zeon / Crossbone Vanguard).
Four rows (S01682, S01683, S01744, S01745) are binary fields mis-extracted as text: left empty and flagged.
uncertain: S01626: 'Federation (F91 era)' is the glossary form but is marked unverified there.

S01631: 'action restriction from damage' read as flinch/stagger.
S01644: torimochi round -> 'sticky round' (no attested English term checked).
S01714: Audhumla 'ittai' -> 'Audhumla (Whole)'; meaning of the record not verified.
S01593: 'approaching units' kept neutral (may mean enemies only).
S01683: treated as binary; if it is a visible label, 'Gun' fits 3 bytes.
